auth_details: Public API requires no authentication or API key for standard endpoints. Fair-use rate limiting applies; contact TVMaze for commercial/high-volume use.
free_tier_limits: Free under CC BY-SA with attribution and ShareAlike; paid plans provide alternative licensing, higher limits, and SLAs.
rate_limits: at least 20 calls every 10 seconds per IP address; clients should back off on HTTP 429
description: TVMaze provides a free public API for television show data: search and lookup by name or ID, episode lists and air dates, cast and crew, images, and country/network schedules. No API key is required for the public endpoints; optional paid/higher-limit access may exist for heavy use. Responses are JSON. Widely used for media apps, calendars, and show metadata enrichment.
resolution_notes: Audited and settled disputes with live web verification on 2026-08-08. free_tier_limits: auditor right — free API is CC BY-SA (not non-commercial only); evidence: https://www.tvmaze.com/api. paid_plans: auditor right — published plans exist (Startup/Small Business/Enterprise); evidence: https://www.tvmaze.com/api/plans. rate_limits: auditor right — docs publish ≥20 calls/10s per IP; evidence: https://www.tvmaze.com/api#rate-limiting. Undisputed fields left as original values.
